topics.title: Live Margin

page.name: Live Margin
page.description: Live P&L and margin by client, with product-wise positions and their trades.

ask: How do I see margins?
Who is short of margin?
Where is the margin shortage?
Which client is using too much margin?
What will the margin be tomorrow?
What was the peak margin today?
Which symbol takes the most margin?
span exposure utilisation available
find: Open Reports in the left sidebar.
Pick Live Margin, under Margin.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type live margin.

figures.name: SPAN Req
figures.meaning: The SPAN margin. The columns before it build it up the way the exchange does.

figures.name: Mrgn Available
figures.meaning: What the client has to cover it.

figures.name: Shortage
figures.meaning: How far the available margin falls short.

figures.name: Mrgn Utlz
figures.meaning: Margin required as a % of margin available. Over 100% is short.

figures.name: T+1 Short
figures.meaning: The shortage tomorrow on today's book.

figures.name: Peak Mrgn
figures.meaning: The day's highest margin. Peak Time says when.

questions.question: How bad did it get today?
questions.answer: Peak Mrgn, with Peak Short and Peak Time.

questions.question: Which symbol eats the margin?
questions.answer: Double click the client and read Share: each symbol's part of Total Mrgn.

topics.title: Hedge Advisory

page.name: Hedge Advisory
page.description: Futures hedges that would cut each account's margin, and what they save.

ask: How can I reduce margin?
Where is hedge advisory?
Which hedge saves the most margin?
What hedge should I take?
What is the margin saving?
Is this hedge advice safe to trade?
futures hedge square off bracket
find: Click Hedge Advisory in the left sidebar, just under the console.
Or press F9 from anywhere.

figures.name: Square Offs
figures.meaning: Hedges that close a position out rather than offset it.

figures.name: Bracket Edge
figures.meaning: Hedges on the edge of a SPAN bracket: a small price move may change the saving.

figures.name: Saving
figures.meaning: Margin freed. Red means the hedge costs more than it saves.

figures.name: Saving %
figures.meaning: The saving as a % of the margin now.

questions.question: Which advice needs care?
questions.answer: Square Offs and Bracket Edge. Inside, a red Negative After means do not trade on it.

topics.title: Add a dealer mapping

page.name: Dealer Mapping
page.description: Assign dealers to specific groups, limits, or terminals.

ask: How do I add a dealer mapping?
How do I map a terminal to a group?
How do I assign a dealer to a group?
new terminal id account code custodian
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Dealer Mapping, under People and access.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type dealer mapping.
how: Click Add New at the top right of the grid.
Pick the Exchange and enter the Terminal ID. Both are required.
Pick the Group, also required. The list comes from Admin+ > Groups, so add the group there first if it is missing.
Optionally enter the Account Code, Dealer Name and Dealer Code.
Tick Custodian if the dealer is a custodian.
Click Save. The new mapping shows in the grid. If the save fails the form stays open with what you entered.

topics.title: Edit a dealer mapping

page.name: Dealer Mapping
page.description: Assign dealers to specific groups, limits, or terminals.

ask: How do I edit a dealer mapping?
How do I change a dealer's group?
How do I change the terminal id of a dealer?
update modify dealer name dealer code custodian
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Dealer Mapping, under People and access.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type dealer mapping.
how: Double click the mapping's row. Its cells open for editing.
Change the Terminal ID, Account Code, Group, Dealer Name, Dealer Code or Custodian. The Exchange cannot be changed; delete the mapping and add it again instead.
Press Enter to save, or Esc to cancel.

topics.title: Delete a dealer mapping

page.name: Dealer Mapping
page.description: Assign dealers to specific groups, limits, or terminals.

ask: How do I delete a dealer mapping?
How do I remove a terminal mapping?
remove unmap dealer terminal
I want to remove a dealer mapping
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Dealer Mapping, under People and access.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type dealer mapping.
how: Click the bin icon at the end of the mapping's row.
Type the row's Terminal ID in the box to confirm.
Click Confirm Delete. This cannot be undone.

topics.title: Upload dealer mappings from a file

page.name: Dealer Mapping
page.description: Assign dealers to specific groups, limits, or terminals.

ask: How do I upload dealer mappings?
How do I add many dealer mappings at once?
import bulk csv file sample
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Dealer Mapping, under People and access.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type dealer mapping.
how: Click Upload Mappings at the top right of the grid. It opens the import page set to dealer mappings.
Download the sample file there to see the columns it expects.
Fill it in, pick it and upload.

topics.title: Add a product mapping

page.name: Product Mapping
page.description: Link market instruments to internal risk product categories.

ask: How do I add a product mapping?
How do I add a symbol?
How do I set the lot size of a new symbol?
new qlot unit multiplier currency instrument
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Product Mapping, under Market data and mapping.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type product mapping.
how: Click Add New at the top right of the grid.
Pick the Exchange and enter the Symbol.
Enter QLot and Multiplier, each 1 or more.
Pick the Unit and the Currency.
Untick Close after save to keep the form open for the next one.
Click Save. The new mapping shows in the grid.

topics.title: Edit a product mapping

page.name: Product Mapping
page.description: Link market instruments to internal risk product categories.

ask: How do I edit a product mapping?
How do I change the lot size of a symbol?
How do I change the multiplier or currency of a product?
update modify qlot unit
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Product Mapping, under Market data and mapping.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type product mapping.
how: Double click the mapping's row. Its cells open for editing.
Change QLot, Unit, Currency or Multiplier. The Exchange and Symbol cannot be changed.
Press Enter to save, or Esc to cancel.
There is no delete on this page.
